welcome.mascotLabel: Hudhud the hoopoe, carrying a letter
welcome.title: A letter from you, five years from now.
welcome.body: Hudhud carries it. Most of it is smudged. Live your year, a week at a time, and the ink will settle.
welcome.promise: No right answers. No clock. Nothing is saved until your family says OK.
